answer.answer: The ski-team coach itinerary is only a sample; passenger-specific airline confirmations control. The youth travels Seattle–Amsterdam–Brussels on August 4–5 and Brussels–Geneva on August 10. The family travels Seattle–London Heathrow–Geneva on August 9–10. All four return together Milan Linate–London Heathrow–Seattle on August 25. Because the return is from Linate rather than Malpensa, the northern Italy finish remains feasible, but the final Italy segment—and preferably the final night in Milan—must be planned around reaching Linate.

claims.value: The ski-team packet's coach itinerary and example booking references are samples, not passenger confirmations, and the working planning note is not proof of a booking. Passenger-specific airline confirmations reviewed on 2026-07-22 are authoritative for booked flights and supersede the packet's sample flights.

The youth outbound is Seattle to Amsterdam to Brussels on August 4-5, 2026, followed by the Brussels-to-Geneva camp transfer on August 10, 2026. As checked on 2026-07-26 06:20 PDT, an official schedule-change notice moved that transfer's departure 85 minutes earlier; its flight number and airports are unchanged, so the camp transfer window must be adjusted.

The family outbound is Seattle to London Heathrow to Geneva on August 9-10, 2026. The shared return has all four travelers—including the youth traveler—flying Milan Linate to London Heathrow to Seattle on August 25, 2026.

The confirmed return departs Milan Linate, not Milan Malpensa. This keeps the northern Italy finish feasible, but the Italy finish must remain compatible with Linate; the working plan calls for three or four days in northern Italy and a final night in Milan if the return continues to leave from Linate.
